fieldData.description: Hello Radix Community and those Looking for something to Celebrate. Come join us at McKibbin's on Bishop Street, Montreal to celebrate the anniversary of the Radix Mainnet Launch. (On the terrace weather permitting) A fun evening with possible live connections to other Radix communities to raise a glass and cheer on as we unleash the Power of the World's First DeFi Engine. Let's have fun, exchange Ideas and mingle with the talented people in the Montreal Web 3 Community. Sign up now and tell a colleague or Friend.
fieldData.name: Radix Comunity Meetup - Montreal
